name: Station A — BoardView.jsx (dashboard UI)
desc: The ONLY dashboard view. All chat, columns, tasks, message rendering live in this one file.

name: Station B — v2-gemini-chat (API endpoint)
desc: POST endpoint. Proxies user chat to Gemini with task-management tools wired in.

name: Station C — messages table (Supabase)
desc: Durable chat log. Both user messages and agent responses live here.

name: Station D — chat-responder (Supabase Edge Function)
desc: Background worker. Claims pending user messages, calls Gemini, writes agent response back.

name: Station E — ChatMessageRenderer.jsx
desc: Canonical markdown renderer for chat bubbles. Uses `marked`.

name: Station A — v2-gemini-chat tool call
desc: Gemini, during chat, calls create_task when user asks for work to be built.

name: Station B — v2-task-create (API endpoint)
desc: POST endpoint. Inserts a new row into Supabase `tasks` table.

name: Station C — tasks table (Supabase)
desc: The queue of work. Source of truth for Live Task View.

name: Station D — v2-task-list (API endpoint)
desc: GET endpoint. Returns tasks for the Live Task View in BoardView.
path: scripts/v2-task-runner.sh` (main orchestrator) + `scripts/v2-runner-watcher.sh` (polls Supabase `runner_start_requested` events every 5s to launch the runner on demand)

name: Station E — Task runner (on home computer / Arch v2 break point)
desc: Polls `tasks` table for `status='queued'`, claims with lease lock (worker_id, locked_at, lease_expires_at), classifies → plans → routes to Claude or Codex → runs QA → marks done.

name: Station F — spawn-agent.sh
desc: Launches a sub-agent Claude Code instance to execute a specific task.

name: Station A — relay-respond.py
desc: Agent sends a response or message to another agent via Supabase.

name: Station B — relay-inbox-{agent}.jsonl
desc: Per-agent inbox of inbound relay messages.

name: Station A — conversations/agents/{slug}.jsonl
desc: Append-only history of an agent's every session.

name: Station B — memory system (MEMORY.md + files)
desc: Persistent cross-session memory. Index shown in every Claude Code session.

name: Station C — projects/{agent}/last-conversation.md
desc: Tape. What's in flight, decisions made, what broke — for the next session.

name: Station B — projects/{agent}/incoming-tasks.md (per-agent inbox)
desc: Where Patrik drops direct tasks to a specific agent. Agent checks on session start.

name: Station C — iMessage bridge (currently shelved)
desc: Route inbound iMessages to Corner as if Patrik typed them in chat.
path: ../aom-studio` deploys to Vercel on push to main

name: Station B — Supabase Edge Functions deploy
desc: chat-responder and any other background workers
